summary:
科磊EPS幾近符合預期，季度營收逾33億美元顯示檢測設備需求平穩。
• EPS 0.89美元，與預期0.88美元接近，超預期幅度0.59%
• 營收33.0億美元，反映半導體檢測需求平穩
• 製程檢測龍頭地位與高毛利模式維持穩定
• 服務營收占比提升強化獲利可預測性
ai_view:
訊號中性：EPS幾近符合預期，季度營收逾33億美元顯示需求平穩，缺乏明確上行催化。短期股價中性，營收年增率未揭露使趨勢判讀有限。中期重點在先進製程與AI晶片資本支出能否延續，以及中國出口管制變化。追蹤指標：訂單能見度、服務營收占比、毛利率、各製程節點需求與中國營收占比。

需留意：EPS幾近持平，缺乏向上驚喜的催化；營收年增率未揭露，需求趨勢方向待確認；高估值下半導體資本支出循環下行風險

summary_en:
KLA landed near in-line on EPS with $3.3B revenue, indicating stable process-control demand.
• EPS of $0.89 came in near the $0.88 estimate, a 0.59% beat
• Revenue of $3.30B reflects stable semiconductor process-control demand
• Process-control leadership and a high-margin model remain steady
• A rising service-revenue mix strengthens earnings predictability

ai_view_en:
Signal is neutral: near-in-line EPS with $3.3B revenue shows stable demand but no clear upside catalyst. Near-term neutral, with undisclosed YoY limiting trend reads. Mid-term the focus is whether advanced-node and AI-chip capex persists, plus China export-control shifts. Track: order visibility, service-revenue mix, gross margin, node-level demand and China revenue exposure.

Watch：EPS essentially in line, lacking an upside-surprise catalyst; Revenue YoY not disclosed, so the demand trend needs confirmation; Cyclical capex-downturn risk at an elevated valuation
beat_or_miss: 符合預期 / EPS僅超預期0.59%基本持平（營收年增率未揭露）。
